title: FORESIGHT-9: Prospective and Process-Aware Evaluation of Adaptive Trading Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.29372v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrospective backtests provide a limited test of adaptive trading agents: they cannot rule out historical contamination, expose sensitivity to a single realized market path, or reveal internal degeneration during long-horizon adaptation. We introduce FORESIGHT-9, a prospective and process-aware benchmark built from nine auditable counterfactual stress worldlines branching from a common July 2026 information boundary. Each worldline specifies staged macro-financial events and joint multi-asset anchors; a deterministic generator realizes the trajectories, while observations are disclosed according to in-world time. A common contract standardizes observations and execution while preserving each agent's native adaptation loop. We evaluate two adaptive trading-agent frameworks with two foundation-model backbones across 36 long-horizon runs. translated_title: FORESIGHT-9：自适应交易代理的前瞻性与过程感知评估
translated_abstract: 回顾性回测对自适应交易代理的测试能力有限：它们无法排除历史数据污染，无法暴露对单一已实现市场路径的敏感性，也无法揭示长周期适应过程中的内部退化。我们提出FORESIGHT-9，一个前瞻性且过程感知的基准，由九条从共同的2026年7月信息边界分叉出的可审计反事实压力世界线构成。每条世界线规定了分阶段的宏观金融事件和联合多资产锚点；轨迹由确定性生成器实现，而观测数据按照世界内时间逐步披露。一个通用合约标准化了观测与执行，同时保留每个代理的原生适应循环。我们在36次长周期运行中评估了两个自适应交易代理框架与两个基础模型骨干的组合。代理排名在不同世界线和骨干模型之间差异显著，而固定的等权重策略表现优于……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出FORESIGHT-9，一个由九条可审计的反事实压力世界线构成的前瞻性、过程感知基准，克服了回顾性回测的局限，能够评估自适应交易代理在长周期适应中的真实表现与内部退化。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces FORESIGHT-9, a prospective and process-aware benchmark built from nine auditable counterfactual stress worldlines that overcomes the limitations of retrospective backtests to evaluate adaptive trading agents under long-horizon adaptation.
